title: Migrate Workstreams/.agents into Ontarch as a pattern
locked_decisions: Agents navigation is an Ontarch-owned pattern seed (packages/ontarch/patterns/agents/), not a new Level 0 package and not live Luckgrid-only profiles inside the package tree.
Working .agents/ stays at the consuming workspace root; ontarch agents-init materializes it and writes .pattern-lock (agents-navigation@0.1.0).
AGENTS_HOME discovery uses env overrides + sentinel walk + standalone WFOS_ROOT/.agents fallback; never filesystem root.
